name: pr-health
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts health run --changed --source eslint,typescript

name: pr-types
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun run typecheck

name: pr-script-types
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun run typecheck:scripts

name: pr-lint
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js src/cli-registry.ts src/commands/hub.ts src/commands/hub-update.ts src/commands/hub-update.test.ts scripts/hubctl-release.test.ts scripts/hub-legacy-migration.test.ts

name: pr-cli-tests
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun test src/commands/hub-update.test.ts src/commands/hub-machine.test.ts src/hub/status.test.ts src/cli-reference-coverage.test.ts src/standard/commands-by-task.test.ts src/standard/help-groups.test.ts

name: pr-helper-tests
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun test scripts/hubctl-release.test.ts scripts/hub-legacy-migration.test.ts

name: pr-package-tests
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun test scripts/package-team-hub.test.ts

name: pr-assets
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun scripts/build-hub-web.ts --check

name: pr-doc-links
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- bun run check:doc-links

name: pr-shell-syntax
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- sh -n deploy/team-hub/hubctl deploy/team-hub/release/bundle.sh deploy/team-hub/release/e2e.sh

name: pr-python-syntax
command: bun --no-env-file src/cli.ts ctx run -- python3 -c 'import ast,pathlib; [ast.parse(pathlib.Path(p).read_text(), filename=p) for p in ["deploy/team-hub/migrate-legacy.py", "deploy/team-hub/release/migrate-legacy.test.py"]]; print("Python AST syntax: 2 files passed")'
